Lines.en: Dave! Sensors detect an unusual influx of guests in Canterlot Castle… and some serious magical chaos!
Bwahaha! Unusual influx? You mean, like… a pony party?!Presided over by Pinkie Pie?I haven't received an invitation!
More than a party. This is TaiShiGong's wedding with the Mane 6.But Celestia isn’t officiating.That's odd.
Bwah?! Not officiating?! Then who’s running the show?!
Bwahahaha! Foolish mortals! I have been sent by the Changeling Queen to claim this celebration! Your precious wedding shall crumble before my undead might!
No cupcakes, no flowers, no happy ponies! Only chaos, despair… and relentless zombie hordes!

To top it all off,your poor brides Mane 6 now lie in my grasp, teetering on the brink of death! Consider your options: allow me to seize Canterlot, or witness your six little ponies become sacrifices!
Mane 6:Help!Somepony ?! ...
No Time For Cupcakes,Dave.We must step up and whup this jerk.
For the Canterlot,for our Mane 6,and their wedding.
I will let him pay...Ready for the hymn to the Love !
Dave… sensors indicate the undead threat has been neutralized. Wedding security restored.
Bwahaha! All zombies toasted, cake still intact, ponies smiling… perfect day!
Grrr… foiled by cupcakes and friendship… How dare… my glorious chaos… be… thwarted?! How on earth am I supposed to explain this to her?!
Enough Pulled Punches ! I will get you next time!
Time For the Disharmony and Discord~~~
All systems normal. Wedding morale: maximum. Dave… enjoy your moment.So do you,TaiShiGong
Come on!Twilight,Rainbow,Fluttershy,Rarity,Applejack,Pinkie!!! Time To Sing The Hymn!!!
Love is in Bloom~
Six beautiful brides and a handsome groom~
Seven hearts becoming one~
A bond that cannot be undone~
